text: maria.partners: @here quick ask — attaching Skyforge Systems co-marketing pack. Need sign-off on logo lockup, hardware schematic illustration rights, and the final case study metrics. Can design/legal/marketing take a pass by EOD PST? Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SkyforgeAssets :wave: sam.design: quick look — hero schematic needs simplification. can we remove connector-level labels for the public hero? need hi-res PNG + SVG. I'll add notes in the Figma file. :eyes: sam.design: propose a 'Skyforge × Redwood' horizontal lockup for the marketplace tile (two-line variant too). cc @akash.legal for trademark flags. akash.legal: two quick legal items: (1) do we have partner's written permission to reproduce the schematic? (2) any restricted mark usage in their brand guidelines? i need partner legal sign-off or an email copy. if not, we'll add a 'Used with permission' line and redact sensitive bits. skyforge-biz: Hi team — confirmed: our legal okays schematic reproduction for marketing, but hardware pinouts must be redacted in public-facing assets. we'll upload a signed permission pdf to the Drive in ~1h. attribution required: 'Used with permission — Skyforge Systems'. emily.marketing: metrics check: draft case study lists '35% latency reduction' and '2.1x cost savings' — can we confirm measurement window and baseline? need numbers for the press deck. @jenna.prod any details? jenna.prod: verified: latency = median p50 pre/post over 30 days (us-east traffic). cost savings = aggregated token cost reduction across batching + quantization pilot over a 60-day run. raw exports in analytics dash: https://redwood.internal/analytics/skyforge-case (request access if needed). akash.legal: based on partner note, legal wants (A) public schematic redacted + watermark, (B) the attribution copy appended to microcopy, and (C) signed pdf attached before publishing. i'll redact the legal template language and drop it in the folder. sam.design: i'll produce two schematic variants: (1) public redacted + accessible alt-text, (2) partner-facing full diagram with watermark. uploading revisions to Drive now -> https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rev-art :arrow_up_small: maria.partners: timeline proposal — design assets by EOD Thu, legal sign-off by Fri noon, marketing final copy by Mon. objections? skyforge-biz: timeline works for us. we'll email the signed permission and metric attestation by Thurs morning. emily.marketing: note for launch: partner requests an embargo until 2026-06-12 10:00 PDT. plan: blog + short tweet thread + partner quote. will draft copy after final metrics. maria.partners: perfect. small badge question — partner wants to include the 'Verified on Redwood' badge in hero and marketplace tiles. @akash.legal any usage restrictions? akash.legal: standard rules apply: must use vector badge, maintain clearspace, no color manipulation. also add the following microcopy. i'll paste approved snippet below. akash.legal: ```html ``` akash.legal: and add this microcopy underneath the badge: 'Redwood verified integration — subject to partner terms.' sam.design: noted. i'll place the badge bottom-right in hero and generate badge/no-badge exports for marketplace variants. will include alt-text and the microcopy. maria.partners: thanks all — i'll compile a final asset checklist and update the Drive folder once revisions are in. will ping when the signed PDF arrives. :thumbsup: skyforge-biz: uploaded signed_permission_skyforge_redwood.pdf to Drive (under /legal). ping if you can't access it. sam.design: got the PDF. pushing final art now, expect version v3 in the folder in ~30m. emily.marketing: once v3 is in i'll slot the blog draft into the content calendar and circulate for approvals. maria.partners: awesome — team velocity on this is great. closing loop after legal posts the redaction note. :raised_hands:
